1.name: Spoiler: Gary Dies
1.overview: After breaking a quantum-interference device, mild-mannered comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must save the universe from imminent destruction.

1.name: Spoiler: Zack's in This One
1.overview: Stuart, Bert, Denise, and Barry Kripke find themselves in an idyllic, peaceful Earth...that happens to be controlled by a repressive and vicious AI.

1.name: Spoiler: Bert Is Magic
1.overview: In a world where magic is real, Bert discovers a gift for sorcery, while Stuart enlists the help of one of this universe’s most powerful wizards.

1.name: Spoiler: Stuart Makes a Wallet
1.overview: Stuart questions what's real after landing in a mental hospital. Kripke finds himself with a new love interest.

1.name: Spoiler: Bert Gets Married
1.overview: The gang arrives in paradise, where everyone lives in harmony with nature and each other. Bert finds true love and the machine is broken.

1.name: Spoiler: Corn Is Delicious
1.overview: As Bert and Kripke team up, Stuart and Denise take a big step forward in a universe that looks and feels normal...with one major difference.

1.name: Spoiler: Dexys Midnight Runners Get a Royalty Payment
1.overview: While attempting to steal a new piece of technology from Caltech, Stuart, Denise, Bert, and Kripke run into some very familiar visitors.

1.name: Spoiler: We're as Confused as You Are
1.overview: After being thrust into a world that is perpetually at war, Stuart must complete his mission before he and the rest of the gang can flee to safety.

1.name: Spoiler: We Couldn't Get Green Lantern
1.overview: After finding themselves trapped in a comic book, Stuart, Denise, Bert, and Kripke must enlist the help of a superhero – and avoid a supervillain!

1.name: Spoiler: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
1.overview: The gang suddenly finds themselves back in the comic book store – but where is that laughter coming from?

originalTitle: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
overview: استوارت بلوم، صاحب فروشگاه کتاب‌های مصور، پس از اینکه به‌طور تصادفی یک چندجهانی جدید ایجاد می‌کند، باید یک دستگاه تداخل کوانتومی پیدا کند تا واقعیت را بازیابی کند.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon and Leonard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke.

tagline: Every universe needs a hero. We got Stuart.
title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
